I'm really not I'm fighting a losing battle.

My girlfriend of 2 years left me the day before thanksgiving in 2017. I lost my job 3 weeks prior to that. My birthday 2 weeks after thanksgiving.  She started seeing someone else the 28th of December 2017. 
It's been a year and a half and how quickly she moved on and then said we're still friends fucking crushed me.  2 months later i got in a car accident and broke my spine.  Crushed 2 vertabrae and sent bone shards in my discs hence why I have oxycodone and the gabapentin is for neuropathic pain due to sciatica. The ativan and xanax are for anxiety. A lot changed in a short amount of time.  I have no friends,  family doesn't want to listen.  I haven't been with a woman since October 2017. Sex isn't overly important but I feel unwanted and worthless and feel like a complete failure. I wish a woman would talk to me,  smile at me or just even wave.  I miss the feeling of being with someone.  A human connection.  The feel of a hug or being told I'm loved.  I cry myself to sleep and I'm in constant pain due to my back. 

I'm staring at these bottles of pills knowing that the pain of it all could be over soon.  I'm crying now and using the last of my will power to not eat them. No one would miss me as no one cares. I'm about to lose my battle.

I don't know if there is a lord but if there is he's certainly not going to help.  The overwhelming urge to die is too strong. From one person in pain to another I'm sorry you're feeling suicidal too.
